# Input

A labeled field for a short typed value.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** The sign-up email.

- **Use it when:** A name, email, phone number or other one-line answer.
- **Not when:** Long text (textarea), or a closed choice (radio group, select or checkbox).

Instead:

- [Textarea](./textarea.md): Several lines.
- [Select](./select.md): A known list of options.

## How Brand expressive uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Field label or column header</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> type.label</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> type.caption</div></div><div class="cap">Labels stay readable on vivid color.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] A visible label, never a placeholder as the only label. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add input
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input/background` | Input fill. | `color.surface.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.default` → `color.neutral.0` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.0` → `color.taupe.light.0` | `color.surface.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.default` → `color.neutral.50` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.50` → `color.taupe.dark.50` |
| `input/border/@` | Input border at rest. | `color.border.strong` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.border.strong` → `color.neutral.500` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.500` → `color.taupe.light.500` | `color.border.strong` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.border.strong` → `color.neutral.400` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.400` → `color.taupe.dark.400` |
| `input/border/focus` | Input border when focused. | `color.border.focus` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.border.focus` → `color.pink.light.600` | `color.border.focus` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.border.focus` → `color.pink.dark.600` |
| `input/text` | Typed text color. | `color.text.primary` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.text.primary` → `color.neutral.900` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.900` → `color.taupe.light.900` | `color.text.primary` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.text.primary` → `color.neutral.900` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.900` → `color.taupe.dark.900` |
| `input/placeholder` | Placeholder text color. | `color.text.muted` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.text.muted` → `color.neutral.600` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.600` → `color.taupe.light.600` | `color.text.muted` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.text.muted` → `color.neutral.400` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.400` → `color.taupe.dark.400` |
| `input/height` | Input height. | `size.control.default` → `size.52` | same |
| `input/padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside an input. | `space.inset.control-x` → `space.28` | same |
| `input/radius` | Input corner radius. | `radius.control` → `brand-expressive.theme.base.radius.control` → `radius.999` | same |
| `input/font-size` | Typed text size. | `type.body.font-size` → `font.size.17` | same |
| `input/disabled/background` | Fill of a disabled input. | `color.disabled.surface` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.disabled.surface` → `color.neutral.100` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.100` → `color.taupe.light.100` | `color.disabled.surface` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.disabled.surface` → `color.neutral.100` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.100` → `color.taupe.dark.100` |
| `input/disabled/border` | Border of a disabled input. | `color.disabled.border` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.disabled.border` → `color.neutral.200` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.200` → `color.taupe.light.200` | `color.disabled.border` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.disabled.border` → `color.neutral.200` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.200` → `color.taupe.dark.200` |
| `input/disabled/text` | Text in a disabled input. | `color.disabled.text` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.disabled.text` → `color.neutral.500` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.500` → `color.taupe.light.500` | `color.disabled.text` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.disabled.text` → `color.neutral.500` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.500` → `color.taupe.dark.500` |
